title: A Signal in the Weather

swarm.name: The Listening Swarm
swarm.blurb: A network of scavenged instruments that collects readings, builds receivers and guards the signals it finds.

arc: The Listening Swarm reaches a hilltop weather station and appears to be preserving an unbroken record by manufacturing observations. In an atmospheric laboratory, the crew discovers that it is measuring them to build a receiver for a reply to a signal it sent earlier. It carries the bearing to an observatory and joins ground sensors to a telescope. Wren identifies the source as a distant rotating star: its repeating pulse is real, but it is not a reply. The crew breaks the defensive network while preserving an independent way to hear the star.

story.intro: The swarm has reached the hilltop weather station. Wren finds fresh solder on an old gauge. Ox holds the door while Kestrel checks its seams.

chapters.title: The daily climb
chapters.text: The path carries scattered readings uphill. Machines gather each scrap. Ox notices they leave the blank pages behind.

chapters.title: A manufactured sky
chapters.text: Collectors shade the hill and store the light. Wren compares a hand reading with a machine reading. The machines are making the weather fit their record.

chapters.title: No missing days
chapters.text: The patrols guard a clock as carefully as the instruments. Kestrel finds a seam in its shutter. The swarm seems determined to keep the record unbroken, whatever it must invent.

story.bossIntro: The Unbroken Observer climbs out of the station. It shutters its clock, summons patrols and sets its gauges against the crew.
story.outro: The clock stops. Among its false readings Wren finds a recurring pulse, too regular for weather. The swarm has carried a copy toward the airborne instruments.

creatures.name: Gap Hound
creatures.blurb: It smells missing entries and charges the nearest witness.
creatures.look: A low brass hound with paper ears, narrow legs and a black nose shaped like a punch.

creatures.name: Kite Spider
creatures.blurb: It stitches small scouts from kite scraps. Cut it down before the air fills.
creatures.look: A blue canvas kite with eight wire legs and dangling white thread.

creatures.name: Sun Collector
creatures.blurb: Its umbrella shuts around a canister of daylight. Break the cover to reach it.
creatures.look: A squat copper cylinder under a wide yellow metal umbrella, with three jointed feet.

creatures.name: Unofficial Double
creatures.blurb: It copies the crew’s moves as readily as it copies a reading.
creatures.look: A silver weather box on stilts, with twin circular glass eyes and a hinged black vane.

creatures.name: Trendline Serpent
creatures.blurb: Its bent body splits when damaged, making one false trend into two.
creatures.look: A long blue segmented ribbon with sharp graph-like bends and small brass wheels.

creatures.name: Cloud Classifier
creatures.blurb: It pins targets in place while it decides what kind of cloud they are.
creatures.look: A white barrel with a rotating funnel, four stubby wheels and gray cotton-like lobes.

creatures.name: Forecast Cadet
creatures.blurb: Its loud forecast calls scouts to enforce the predicted weather.
creatures.look: A thin tin figure in a blue raincoat, with a horn head and a box of spinning vanes.

creatures.name: Relay Mender
creatures.blurb: It patches damaged patrols with strips of observation paper. Stop it first.
creatures.look: A green wheeled sewing machine with brass arms and a roll of cream paper.

creatures.name: Extremes Sorter
creatures.blurb: Its hot and cold clamps wind up a crushing pull.
creatures.look: A tall iron frame with one orange clamp, one blue clamp and two glass tubes.

creatures.name: Panorama Stitcher
creatures.blurb: It sweeps the tower with a stitched false horizon, leaving the crew exposed.
creatures.look: A bronze rotating tripod with four camera eyes and long strips of blue fabric.

creatures.name: Enclosure Keeper
creatures.blurb: It shields other machines while trying to box up anything that moves.
creatures.look: A white slatted cage on thick wheels, with a hinged roof and two hook arms.

creatures.name: Unbroken Observer
creatures.blurb: It manufactures weather and calls patrols to preserve an unbroken record. Its clock keeps ticking behind a shutter.
creatures.look: A tower on four climbing legs, built from white slatted boxes, brass clock faces and a huge black rain gauge.

creatures.name: Hill Observer
creatures.blurb: An independent observer checks the machines against a hand reading and tends the crew.
creatures.look: A stout figure in a tan raincoat with a handheld glass gauge and a canvas satchel.

creatures.name: Kite Scout
creatures.blurb: A hand-built scout carries cover to anyone caught on the climb.
creatures.look: A small teal diamond kite with a wooden frame and a broad cloth tail.

events.look: A canvas bag beside a steep stone path and a brass token.
events.title: The last climb
events.text: A relay needs one last runner. It can spare a medical kit or a pouch of coins, but not both.

options.label: Carry the kit uphill
options.result: Wren uses the supplies after the climb.

options.label: Carry the coin pouch
options.result: The relay lets the crew keep the pouch.

events.look: Two glass gauges on a wooden sill, one bending in the wind.
events.title: Two readings
events.text: A hand gauge and an automated station disagree. There is time to salvage one useful part before the gust arrives.

options.label: Take the guard plate
options.result: Ox fits the plate to his shield.

options.label: Take the brass fittings
options.result: Kestrel pockets the fittings.

events.look: Loose cream sheets blowing around a gray scanner.
events.title: Loose observations
events.text: A box of observations spills beside a scanner. The crew can save a repair guide or a valuable set of instrument parts.

options.label: Save the repair guide
options.result: Wren keeps the guide dry.

options.label: Save the instrument parts
options.result: The parts survive the wind.

events.look: A teal kite tangled in a wire antenna above a workbench.
events.title: Tangled line
events.text: A kite team offers one item for freeing its line: spare bandages or a sturdy length of cord.

options.label: Take bandages
options.result: Wren dresses the crew’s scrapes.

options.label: Take the cord
options.result: Ox rigs the cord to his shield.

events.look: Two stone paths with bright dots and a small open supply tin.
events.title: Fork in the trail
events.text: A volunteer offers either a sheltered route with a rest or a steep shortcut past a salvage cache. There is time for only one.

options.label: Rest on the sheltered route
options.result: The crew reaches the summit in better shape.

options.label: Take the steep shortcut
options.result: The crew recovers the cache.

events.look: A glass canister full of yellow light beside a metal shutter.
events.title: Stored sunshine
events.text: A collector’s canister can power a repair lamp or be traded intact. Opening it makes it worthless as salvage.

options.label: Open it for repairs
options.result: Wren works by the released light.

options.label: Keep it sealed
options.result: The intact canister finds a buyer.

acts.name: Blue Hill Observatory and Science Center

story.intro: The trail leads into a laboratory of aircraft and sensors. Ox makes room for Wren to compare the pulse with an independent gauge. Kestrel watches the machines turn toward them.

chapters.title: Instruments in motion
chapters.text: Probes fall and radar scans cross overhead. The swarm samples the air around the crew. Its machines send every reading onward.

chapters.title: The turn
chapters.text: Wren separates the pulse from the weather data. It is a reply to a signal the swarm sent before it reached the hill. The crew are being measured because their instruments can help locate its source.

chapters.title: A network of parts
chapters.text: Fabricators replace broken sensors while aircraft carry measurements between them. Kestrel traces their cables to a single assembly. The swarm is building a larger receiver.

story.bossIntro: The End-to-End Observatory deploys probes and sweeps the floor. Its repair arms keep the receiver alive while it searches for the reply.
story.outro: The receiver falls silent. Its last bearing points beyond the atmosphere, toward a distant repeating source. The swarm takes that bearing to the telescopes.

creatures.name: Sonde Mites
creatures.blurb: The falling probes split into smaller drills when damaged.
creatures.look: A cluster of white cylinders with orange fins and fine black drill tips.

creatures.name: Flux Tripod
creatures.blurb: It moves heat between its legs and leaves a target unsteady.
creatures.look: A three-legged silver mast with blue and orange coils and a square sensor head.

creatures.name: Cloud Hunter
creatures.blurb: It follows dense mist, then dives at whatever disturbed it.
creatures.look: A dark gray winged radar pod with a circular nose and two narrow fins.

creatures.name: Lidar Pair
creatures.blurb: Alternating beams pin the crew while the instruments compare them.
creatures.look: Two pale blue cylinders joined by a jointed arm, each with a glass lens and spindly feet.

creatures.name: Aperture Crawler
creatures.blurb: It folds metal windows over itself before closing in.
creatures.look: A low black six-legged machine with overlapping silver window plates and a round lens.

creatures.name: Catalog Collector
creatures.blurb: It maps the crew’s route and sends interceptors ahead.
creatures.look: A wheeled green cabinet with a folding dish and a fan of thin mechanical arms.

creatures.name: Calibration Chamber
creatures.blurb: It repairs nearby sensors against a false reference. Break its cycle first.
creatures.look: A cream insulated box on four legs with a circular door and blue coils.

creatures.name: Archive Custodian
creatures.blurb: It protects its instruments and tries to crate the crew as specimens.
creatures.look: A brown wheeled crate with clamp arms, a lid like a jaw and brass hinges.

creatures.name: Boundary Stakes
creatures.blurb: The stakes build a perimeter and call more sensors into it.
creatures.look: A cluster of tall black stakes with wire branches, orange tips and low mesh skirts.

creatures.name: Airborne Array
creatures.blurb: Separate beams herd the crew into a sweeping pass.
creatures.look: A broad gray aircraft-shaped machine with four propellers and rectangular blue radar panels.

creatures.name: Fabrication Rig
creatures.blurb: It cuts spare parts from the room to repair the sensor network.
creatures.look: A yellow gantry on tracks with three cutting arms and a tray of silver components.

creatures.name: End-to-End Observatory
creatures.blurb: It deploys probes, sweeps the crew and repairs its network. The measurements are a search for a signal, not a hunt for weather.
creatures.look: A silver aircraft fuselage mounted over a tracked workshop, with a radar dish, crane arms and open instrument crates.

creatures.name: Reference Standard
creatures.blurb: This independent gauge helps Wren check and repair corrupted instruments.
creatures.look: A small cream case with a round glass dial, two folding legs and a copper handle.

creatures.name: Workshop Rig
creatures.blurb: A portable workbench makes a shield from the parts the crew salvages.
creatures.look: A low blue wheeled workbench with two clamp arms and a curved metal plate.

events.look: A white probe stuck in paving beside an open metal case.
events.title: Last reading
events.text: A probe transmits from beneath the floor. Its case holds either a medical pack or a set of valuable fittings; a tremor leaves time to grab one.

options.label: Grab the medical pack
options.result: Wren treats the crew as the floor shakes.

options.label: Grab the fittings
options.result: The crew escapes with the fittings.

events.look: Two silver gauges beside an open insulated chamber.
events.title: A known reference
events.text: One gauge is compromised. The working reference can teach the crew a repair method or be sold to fund supplies.

options.label: Study the reference
options.result: Wren learns to clear a corrupted reading.

options.label: Trade the reference
options.result: The crew receives a pouch of coins.

events.look: A glowing map beside a clock and two diverging corridors.
events.title: Five minutes early
events.text: A catalog predicts the crew’s arrival. The early route has a supply case; the late route gives time to practice a counterattack.

options.label: Take the supply case
options.result: The crew gets the case before the patrol arrives.

options.label: Practice the counterattack
options.result: Kestrel finds a way through a shield.

events.look: A yellow cutting arm reaching for a bridge support beside a metal crate.
events.title: Feed the rig
events.text: The rig will accept either a coin pouch or the metal crate in place of the bridge support. The crate contains a useful guard plate.

options.label: Give up the coins
options.result: The rig takes the pouch and the crate stays with the crew.

options.label: Give up the crate
options.result: Kestrel studies the cutting arm while it consumes the plate.

events.look: Black stakes forming a widening ring around a small green box.
events.title: Closing perimeter
events.text: A cache sits inside a growing ring. The crew can retrieve its coins or use the remaining time to rest outside.

options.label: Enter for the coins
options.result: The crew slips out with the coins before the gap closes.

options.label: Rest outside
options.result: Wren tends the crew while the stakes unfold.

events.look: A radar dish sweeping mist over a parked gray vehicle.
events.title: Moving shadow
events.text: A radar shadow crosses a parked vehicle. Following it leads to a spare shield; crossing later leads to a pouch of salvage.

options.label: Follow the shadow
options.result: Ox takes the spare shield.

options.label: Cross later
options.result: The crew collects the salvage after the scan passes.

story.intro: At the observatory, ground sensors and domes turn together. Ox steadies a manual sight while Wren checks the bearing. Kestrel follows the cables toward the largest eye.

chapters.title: A joined network
chapters.text: Seismic stations and weather sensors feed the same receiver. Patrols protect their cables. The swarm is using every instrument it can reach to hear the signal.

chapters.title: The source
chapters.text: Wren compares the pulse with the manual sight. It comes from a distant rotating star, repeating as it turns. It is not a message addressed to the swarm.

chapters.title: An answer to keep
chapters.text: The machines still defend the signal and silence anything that interferes. Ox holds a route open. Kestrel finds where the dome eye joins the ground network.

story.bossIntro: The All-Sky Observatory raises its eye. It calls defenders, sweeps the approach and repairs its sensors to keep hearing the pulse.
story.outro: The network comes apart. The pulse continues in Wren’s independent receiver: a star turning, not a caller waiting for an answer. Ox lowers the shield. Kestrel leaves the manual sight aimed at the sky.

creatures.name: Radiometer Moth
creatures.blurb: It follows heat and dives at the brightest target.
creatures.look: A moth with copper wings, a black spherical body and two round amber lenses.

creatures.name: Motion Collector
creatures.blurb: It stores the force of footsteps for a heavy kick.
creatures.look: A squat gray beetle with spring legs, a weighted tail and a round glass gauge.

creatures.name: Orbit Sweeper
creatures.blurb: It spins a protective ring before catching whatever moves.
creatures.look: A silver saucer with three rotating black hoops and a single blue lens.

creatures.name: Seismic Chorus
creatures.blurb: Its tapping summons more sensors to the crew’s position.
creatures.look: Five bronze cones on little feet connected by loose black cables.

creatures.name: Archive Sorter
creatures.blurb: It clamps a target while sorting incoming signals from outgoing ones.
creatures.look: A cream sorting cabinet on wheels with two chutes and long rubber-tipped arms.

creatures.name: Continuity Mechanic
creatures.blurb: It welds damaged receivers back into the network.
creatures.look: A blue wheeled tool chest with a welding arm, brass claws and a hinged round visor.

creatures.name: Network Graft
creatures.blurb: It wraps cables around other machines to shield them.
creatures.look: A black cable trunk with branching copper wires and a flat gray base on wheels.

creatures.name: Report Binder
creatures.blurb: It repeats the last action it has recorded.
creatures.look: A thick gray metal binder with a circular lens and four articulated brass corners.

creatures.name: Seismicity Mapper
creatures.blurb: It marks the crew with a grid and summons machines to the coordinates.
creatures.look: A flat white drone with four rotor rings and a downward-pointing green lens.

creatures.name: Warning Bell Buoy
creatures.blurb: Its folding barriers protect the network and sweep the approach clear.
creatures.look: A tall orange buoy on a wheeled base with a bronze bell and four folding gray barriers.

creatures.name: Cardinal Dome
creatures.blurb: Four rotating wings drive its heavy charge through shields.
creatures.look: A low stone-colored dome on four broad mechanical legs, each bearing a rectangular wing.

creatures.name: All-Sky Observatory
creatures.blurb: Its ground sensors summon defenders while its eye sweeps the crew. It repairs the network to keep a distant reply from fading.
creatures.look: A huge white dome on a ring of black sensor legs, with a blue glass eye and branching copper cables.

creatures.name: Tactile Guide
creatures.blurb: A guide reads raised stars by touch and helps the crew navigate the dark.
creatures.look: A figure in a dark blue coat holding a round black board covered in raised silver dots.

creatures.name: Museum Keeper
creatures.blurb: A keeper carries manual instruments and mends damaged gear.
creatures.look: A figure in a brown work coat with a brass handheld telescope and a green tool bag.

events.look: Five bronze ground sensors around two small cases.
events.title: Five taps
events.text: One station has moved. Comparing the taps reveals two caches, but the patrol will return before both can be opened.

options.label: Open the medical case
options.result: Wren distributes its supplies.

options.label: Open the parts case
options.result: Kestrel takes the valuable parts.

events.look: A spring-legged recorder beside a locked toolbox.
events.title: A day of footsteps
events.text: A recorder will open its toolbox for a matching rhythm. Its battery has enough charge to unlock one of two compartments.

options.label: Unlock the shield compartment
options.result: Ox takes the folding plate.

options.label: Unlock the cash compartment
options.result: The crew takes the emergency fund.

events.look: A brass telescope and a canvas medical roll on a stone shelf.
events.title: Manual instruments
events.text: A keeper offers a manual sight or a medical roll. The other must stay for the next visitor.

options.label: Take the medical roll
options.result: Wren uses the clean dressings.

options.label: Study the sight
options.result: Kestrel learns to pick out an exposed joint.

events.look: A dark circular board with raised silver stars and a small tool pouch.
events.title: Raised stars
events.text: A tactile map has lost three stars. The guide offers either a lesson in feeling the route or a pouch of spare fittings.

options.label: Learn the route
options.result: The crew learns to check its bearings without a display.

options.label: Take the fittings
options.result: The guide gives the crew the spare parts.

events.look: Gray scaffold poles forming both a ramp and a cage.
events.title: One set of supports
events.text: A scaffold can be redirected into a sheltered rest or dismantled for valuable metal. There is only enough time for one.

options.label: Make a shelter
options.result: The crew rests under the new ramp.

options.label: Salvage the supports
options.result: Kestrel pulls the metal free.

events.look: A closed astronomy kit beside a blue canvas supply bag.
events.title: The lost kit
events.text: A courier recovers a school kit and offers the crew a choice of supplies in thanks: a repair pack or a coin pouch.

options.label: Take the repair pack
options.result: Wren repairs damaged gear.

options.label: Take the coin pouch
options.result: The crew takes the travel fund.
